## Learning goals

- I can compare fonts at the size people will actually see.
- I can judge whether a background, outline, shadow, or 3D effect improves readability.
- I can keep style without letting effects hide the letter shapes.

::: {.callout-note}
The figures below support the [BBC guidance for visually and hearing impaired audiences](https://www.bbc.com/editorialguidelines/guidance/visually-and-hearing-impaired-audiences). They are kept beside the exact design decision they demonstrate.
